name: TEED edges
plain: TEED (Soria et al., 2023): a tiny edge detector (58 k parameters) that draws soft edge maps for the soft-edge ControlNet, quantized to a few levels by default. MIT code and weights (trained on BIPED, a research-use dataset; see the card).
summary: Tiny and efficient edge detector (Soria et al., ICCV 2023 workshops; controlnet_aux `TEEDdetector`, ComfyUI's "TEED Soft-Edge Lines"): a 58 k-parameter network whose four outputs are averaged into a soft edge map, quantized to a few levels by default.

papers.title: Tiny and Efficient Model for The Edge Detection Generalization

no_kernels_reason: a 58 k-parameter CNN that runs in a few ms; no custom kernel measured to pay off
task_io: Input: one RGB image. Output: a line / edge map `[H, W]` in [0, 1] at the input size (1 = line), the ControlNet preprocessors (line art, HED, PiDiNet, TEED / Anyline); M-LSD also returns straight line segments.

variants.name: teed

training_data.name: BIPED (Barcelona Images for Perceptual Edge Detection)

licence.training_note: BIPED (the repository's checkpoints/BIPED folder and README); the dataset is for non-commercial use.

variants.input_size: any H x W >= 32, padded to a multiple of 32

portable.protocol: first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

original16.protocol: median of 5 after 3 warm-up, uint8 CUDA input, original code at the pinned commit, torch.no_grad; peak = max over the first call and the timed calls
